title: Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO Details
intro:
Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO is a book build issue of ₹1,757.00 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 15.21 lakh shares aggregating to ₹150.00 crores and offer for sale of 1.63 crore shares aggregating to ₹1,607.00 crores.

Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO bidding opened for subscription on Aug 24, 2026 and will close on Aug 27, 2026. The allotment for the Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 28, 2026. Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 1, 2026.

Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO is set issue price band at ₹938 to ₹988 per share. The lot size for an application is 15 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,820 (15 shares) (based on upper price).

The issue includes a reservation of up to 33,408 shares for employees offered at a discount of ₹90.00 to the issue price.

JM Financial Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2002, Symbiotec Pharmalab Ltd. is a pharmaceutical and biotechnology company engaged in the development and manufacturing of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), nutritional ingredients, and specialty products. The company serves domestic and international markets across regulated and emerging regions.

With over 30 years of industry experience, Symbiotec Pharmalab has evolved from a lab-scale steroidal hormone API manufacturer in 1995 into an industrial-scale, backward-integrated manufacturing platform. The company has approvals from the United States Food and Drug Administration (US FDA), European Union Good Manufacturing Practices (EU-GMP), Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, Korea, and other global regulatory organisations.

As of June 30, 2025, the company operated two industrial-scale API manufacturing facilities with a maximum chemical synthesis capacity of 584.67 metric tonnes (MT) and fermentation capacity of 300 kilolitres.

Symbiotec Pharmalab focuses on research-driven manufacturing, quality compliance, and sustainable production processes. It supports the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and wellness industries by providing high-quality ingredients aligned with global standards.
strengths: Global leadership in corticosteroid and steroidal hormone APIs.
Long-standing relationships with domestic and international customers.
Fully invested, multi-scale, vertically integrated manufacturing platform with sustainable practices and a strong regulatory track record.
Continuous investment in research and development, supported by strong technological capabilities among Indian industry peers.
Ability to leverage its scientific expertise and existing capabilities to expand its total addressable market and develop intellectual property-driven offerings.

Incorporated in 2002, Symbiotec Pharmalab Ltd. is a pharmaceutical and biotechnology company engaged in the development and manufacturing of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), nutritional ingredients, and specialty products. The company serves domestic and international markets across regulated and emerging regions.

With over 30 years of industry experience, Symbiotec Pharmalab has evolved from a lab-scale steroidal hormone API manufacturer in 1995 into an industrial-scale, backward-integrated manufacturing platform. The company has approvals from the United States Food and Drug Administration (US FDA), European Union Good Manufacturing Practices (EU-GMP), Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, Korea, and other global regulatory organisations.

As of June 30, 2025, the company operated two industrial-scale API manufacturing facilities with a maximum chemical synthesis capacity of 584.67 metric tonnes (MT) and fermentation capacity of 300 kilolitres.

Symbiotec Pharmalab focuses on research-driven manufacturing, quality compliance, and sustainable production processes. It supports the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and wellness industries by providing high-quality ingredients aligned with global standards.

faqs.question: How to apply in Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO will be done on Friday, August 28, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Aug 31, 2026 . Check the Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO allotment status .
